theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have sapp {α} {a b c d : List α} (h1 : List.Subset a c) (h2 : List.Subset b d) : List.Subset (a ++ b) (c ++ d) := by
    intro x h
    cases List.mem_append.1 h with
    | inl h => exact List.mem_append_left _ (h1 h)
    | inr h => exact List.mem_append_right _ (h2 h)
  intro Hnorm
  induction post
  case const => intro _ h; cases h
  case bvar => intro _ h; cases h
  case fvar => intro _ h; cases h
  case op => intro _ h; cases h
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm with
    | abs h => exact ih h
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm with
    | quant h1 h2 => exact sapp (trih h1) (eih h2)
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm with
    | ite h1 h2 h3 => exact sapp (sapp (cih h1) (tih h2)) (eih h3)
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm with
    | eq h1 h2 => exact sapp (ih1 h1) (ih2 h2)
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    cases Hnorm with
    | app H1 H2 Hn =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · intro x h
      exact List.mem_append_right _ h
    · next Hfalse =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ⟨⟩
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · exact sapp (fn_ih H1) (e_ih H2)
